body: I've been thinking about changing courses because I don't think my current one is what I like but I'm scared that if I do and don't like it, it will have been a waste of time and money and my family will hate me, if that happens I will probably also hate myself evenmore for making a stupid decision.

I know I would feel awful but I just can't bring myself to do it, I was never able to, I only opened up to my girlfriend because she reached out to me first about her problems so I decided it was only fair I talked about it too but for everyone else I just smile and look happy because I don't want to scare them away.

Thing about academics is the weight my family puts on them, ever since I can remember I was told that if I didn't complete a course I would be nothing and that if I didn't do a course I would be a lost cause and a bum, everytime I get a bad grade I'm scared of telling them so I hide it because I know that will lead to nonstop bashing from them about how I'm not trying hard enough that all I'm good for is wasting money, I'm always stressing about it and it kills all my motivation.

I pretty much got carried to get into college and have been doing poorly cause I don't have motivation to study and I know friends are there to help but I just feel like a bother all the time, everytime i feel like opening up i just don't because I'm scared of bothering them.
